channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula diz à diretora-geral do FMI que nunca foi esquerdista
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated in an informal conversation during the G7 summit in France that he never considered himself 'a leftist'. The remark was made to IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva and the German Chancellor while discussing the global political landscape. The comment was picked up by microphones and reported by O Antagonista.

item.title: Partidos pressionam TSE por mudanças em regras de campanha
item.description: Party leaders met with the president of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE), Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, to push for changes in campaign rules that would allow mass messaging via apps during elections. The proposal, already approved by the Chamber of Deputies, awaits Senate vote. The meeting aims to secure institutional support for the measure, which could influence the dynamics of the 2026 electoral campaigns.

item.title: Falta ao Brasil uma estratégia para lidar com a doutrina Donroe
item.description: Brazil lacks a clear strategy to confront the Monroe Doctrine — referred to in the text as 'Donroe' — which asserts U.S. dominance over the Western Hemisphere through economic, financial, technological, and military coercion. Both Bolsonaro allies and Lula mistakenly believe Trump will aid them in the 2026 elections, but the U.S. president treats all Brazilian actors indifferently, viewing Brazil as merely part of America's strategic backyard. The real dilemma for Brazil is defining its global role: to become a neutral, resource-rich middle power, it needs strategic intelligence and internal cohesion, which have been absent for decades.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro pede retomada de sanções contra Moraes um dia após condenação no STF
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro urged U.S. President Donald Trump to reinstate sanctions against Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, one day after being convicted in the coup plot case. He was sentenced to four years and two months in semi-open prison and fined R$165,000 for coercion. The request aims to pressure Brazil's judiciary through foreign influence.

item.title: G7: Macron celebra 'gol' para a Ucrânia, mas Lula sai insatisfeito com resultado da cúpula
item.description: French President Emmanuel Macron celebrated the G7 summit outcome in Évian as a 'goal' for Ukraine, emphasizing renewed international support for the country in its conflict with Russia. Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, however, expressed dissatisfaction, criticizing the lack of progress on issues such as climate justice and reform of the global financial system, which he views as essential for Global South nations.

item.title: Nunes Marques será relator de ação de Flávio contra Lula
item.description: Minister Kassio Nunes Marques was randomly assigned by the STF as rapporteur of the criminal complaint filed by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro against President Lula, following Lula’s remarks calling Bolsonaro’s sons 'traitors of the homeland' and likening them to Joaquim Silvério dos Reis, the informant in the Inconfidência Mineira. Flávio’s defense claims Lula incited homicide by hanging. The electronic draw took place on May 17, 2026.

item.title: Empatados em pesquisa para presidência, Renan Santos e Caiado focam em reduzir desconhecimento
item.description: Renan Santos (Missão) and Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) are tied at 3% voting intention in the latest Quaest poll, but face high levels of voter unfamiliarity — 70% and 48%, respectively. Both are working to increase visibility through social media, nationwide travel, and investor events, while raising funds via a virtual crowdfunding campaign and the minimum electoral fund quota to bolster their 2026 presidential pre-campaigns.

item.title: Câmara aprova anistia a multas por bloqueios de estrada após eleição de 2022; texto também reforça piso do frete
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved a provisional measure that pardons fines imposed on truckers for road blockades in 2022 following the presidential elections, via a 'jabuti' inserted by rapporteur Zé Trovão (PL-SC). The text also strengthens the minimum freight floor, sets a national minimum wage of R$5,000 for long-distance truckers, and includes provisions such as reduced adaptation periods and subcontracting of autonomous transporters. The proposal now moves to the Senate and, if approved, will require presidential sanction.

item.title: Crusoé: Eduardo recebe uma mensagem de apoio vinda da Hungria
item.description: Former federal deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro received a supportive message from former Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orbán following his conviction by Brazil's Supreme Court for coercion. Orbán posted on X that the statement against Eduardo was 'outrageous' and expressed solidarity. Eduardo acknowledged the international support in his response.

item.title: Presidentes de partidos pedem a Nunes Marques em reunião no TSE apoio a projeto que beneficia siglas e flexibilização de disparos em massa
item.description: Party presidents met with Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, president of the TSE, to discuss demands for the 2026 elections, including loosening rules on mass messaging via apps, better debt negotiation terms, maximum fine limits, and an increase in the electoral fund. Podemos leader Renata Abreu sought institutional support to advance a bill already passed by the Chamber and pending in the Senate. Despite attendance from PT, PL, União Brasil, PP, PSD, MDB, and Republicanos representatives, the electoral fund increase was denied due to lack of budgetary expansion, while Nunes Marques said he would evaluate the presented demands.

item.title: "Em queda, Flávio Bolsonaro finge até defender Bolsa Família", diz PT
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) accused Senator Flávio Bolsonaro of pretending to support the Bolsa Família program despite his past criticisms, noting his declining poll numbers. The party's social media post highlighted previous statements by Flávio and Jair Bolsonaro opposing the benefit and emphasized his recent proposal to extend the protection rule for beneficiaries who obtain formal employment. Flávio's remarks came after a Genial/Quaest poll showed Lula leading with 39% and Flávio at 29% in 2026 presidential vote intentions.

item.title: Contato de Lula com Trump no G-7 vai de ‘bom trabalho’ a embate sobre as eleições no Brasil
item.description: The meeting between Lula and Trump at the G-7 began with a 'good job' exchanged in the corridors but ended in tension, with Lula criticizing Trump's 'imperial' behavior following U.S. tariff threats and the labeling of Brazilian groups as criminal. Trump later remarked that Brazil is 'politically dangerous' and referenced the arrest of Bolsonaro Jr., intensifying the clash over Brazil's 2026 elections.

item.title: TSE publica acórdão que confirma condenação de Castro e pode impactar sucessão no Rio
item.description: The TSE published the ruling upholding the conviction of Claudio Castro, confirming his ineligibility and rejecting appeals from both the former governor and the Electoral Prosecutor's Office. Minister Flávio Dino of the STF had been awaiting this publication to resume the case defining Rio's succession format, but has not yet released the action despite a prior 4-1 vote favoring indirect elections. Due to the delay between the STF and TSE and the interim governance of Judge Ricardo Couto, there is no longer sufficient time to organize a direct election, even if the Supreme Court decides in favor of it.

item.title: ‘Nikolas Ferreira da esquerda’, Pedro Rousseff quer comandar guerra digital do PT
item.description: Pedro Rousseff, Belo Horizonte city councilor and Dilma Rousseff’s grand-nephew, was appointed by Lula to coordinate the PT’s digital strategy for the 2026 elections. He advocates for an institutional role for Lula while urging militant and allied figures to take an aggressive stance on social media, including targeting Bolsonaro allies like Flávio Bolsonaro, whom he said must be 'crushed to dust'. Rousseff also highlighted the launch of the 'Porta-Vozes do Presidente Lula' program to counter fake news and boost the government’s online presence.

item.title: Liminar manda governo federal suspender impulsionamento de publicidade sobre escala 6×1
item.description: Federal Judge Pollyanna Martins Alves of the 1st Federal Civil Court of the Distrito Federal ordered the federal government to suspend, within 48 hours, paid promotion of content regarding the reduction of the 6×1 work scale on social media (YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, and X), and to halt further spending until Congress evaluates PEC 221/2019. The ruling responds to a popular action filed by Deputy Carlos Jordy (PL-RJ), who claims the government spent at least R$ 1.5 million on Meta-paid ads since May 7, including R$ 881,000 between April 15 and 18 — a period coinciding with the bill’s review in the Chamber’s Constitution and Justice Committee.

item.title: G7 pressiona líderes de big techs a protegerem crianças no avanço da IA
item.description: G7 leaders, including Brazil, urged major tech companies to develop tools to protect children online amid AI advancements, citing risks like image manipulation and exploitation. Lula condemned harmful uses of AI, advocated for multilateral regulation, and highlighted Pix as a model of public digital infrastructure that reduces inequality. The joint statement was also endorsed by South Korea, Egypt, India, and Kenya.

item.title: TSE publica acórdão que confirma inelegibilidade de Castro e mantém posição sobre nova eleição no RJ
item.description: The TSE confirmed the ineligibility of former Rio de Janeiro governor Cláudio Castro (PL) and upheld the order for a new election to fill the remaining term, without specifying whether it will be direct or indirect. The decision depends on the STF, whose deliberation has been stalled since April, with a 4-1 majority favoring an indirect election. In the interim, TJ-RJ president Ricardo Couto serves as acting governor, stating he expected to serve only a few days but now anticipates 90 days or more.

item.title: Lula brinca sobre 'contratar' Messi para jogar na Seleção
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva joked during a press conference about the possibility of 'hiring' Lionel Messi to play for the Brazilian national team after Messi’s hat-trick in his 2026 World Cup debut. The remark was made in a lighthearted manner, with no political or practical intent, amid widespread attention on Messi’s performance. The comment reflects Lula’s tendency to use sports events as a platform for casual, symbolic engagement.

item.title: STF ajusta responsabilidade de plataformas sobre conteúdos postados
item.description: The STF approved a new thesis on digital platforms' liability for user-posted content, preserving the expansion of big techs' responsibility and shifting it from Article 19 to Article 21 of the Marco Civil da Internet. The decision introduces joint liability and relative presumption of fault, requiring platforms to remove illegal content upon notification without a court order, and ratifies presidential decrees giving 60 days for compliance — potentially weakening opposition bills seeking to annul Lula's decree.

item.title: Flávio promete “péssima notícia para o CV, o PCC e o PT”
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) unveiled the first part of his public security government plan in São Paulo on Thursday, proposing to classify criminal factions such as CV, PCC, and groups linked to the PT as terrorist organizations under Brazilian law. The announcement was accompanied by an AI-generated video shared on social media, in which Bolsonaro stated the measure would be "bad news" for these groups. The proposal aims to strengthen legal tools against organized crime through harsher legislation.

item.title: Lula en un corrillo del G-7: “Yo nunca fui un izquierdista”
item.description: Lula da Silva, 80, seeking a third term, told the IMF chief and German chancellor at the G-7 in France that he was never a leftist but a union leader. The remarks, caught on an open mic, were part of a private conversation. He is preparing to run in Brazil’s October 2026 presidential election.

item.title: Aliados nacionais, União e PP tentam conter disputas locais na federação
item.description: Leaders of União Brasil and PP state that the União Progressista federation will adopt regional negotiations to prevent local disputes from undermining national unity. The strategy aims to harmonize state-level interests to preserve the bloc's political strength in the 2026 elections and enhance its congressional articulation, despite historical differences between the parties in some states.

item.title: Nunes Marques é sorteado relator de processo de Flávio contra Lula por ‘ameaça’
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Kassio Nunes Marques was randomly assigned as rapporteur of a case filed by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro against President Lula, alleging threats and incitement to crime. The case stems from a statement made by Lula on June 2 during the inauguration of the Federal University of ABC’s campus. The legal action could heighten institutional tensions between the Judiciary and the Executive Branch.

item.title: Marinho chama Lula de “camaleão” após fala sobre não ser de esquerda
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho (PL-RN) called President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) a 'chameleon' after Lula stated, in an open-mic conversation with the IMF managing director and the German chancellor, that he 'was never a leftist'. Marinho accused Lula of shifting his rhetoric according to political circumstances and criticized his foreign policy, advocating for a more pragmatic approach centered on Brazil's strategic interests.

item.title: Com apenas dois aliados, Mendonça assume posto de ‘líder da minoria’ no STF
item.description: André Mendonça emerged as the leader of the minority on the Supreme Federal Court (STF) after winning a 3-1 vote in the Second Chamber, upholding the detention of Daniel Vorcaro’s father and uncle in the Banco Master case. Despite being part of a minority bloc, he secured victory with the steadfast support of Kassio Nunes Marques and Luiz Fux, aided by Dias Toffoli’s recusal. Mendonça used the occasion to denounce Vorcaro’s defense for proposing selective plea bargains, asserting his refusal to yield to pressure and seeking public approval amid the electoral period.

item.title: Bolsonaro diz que arma apreendida é legal e que seguranças a deixaram inoperante
item.description: Bolsonaro's defense told the STF that the 9mm Glock pistol seized from a member of his security team was legally registered in his name and handed over for maintenance after detecting a malfunction. The security team allegedly removed the firing pin, rendering the weapon inoperable without Bolsonaro's knowledge, citing psychiatric medication affecting his cognition. The seizure occurred on June 15, and the defense denies any link to the end of his house arrest, which concludes next week.

item.title: PT diz que Flávio Bolsonaro está 'em queda nas pesquisas' e 'finge até defender o Bolsa Família'
item.description: The PT criticized Flávio Bolsonaro for claiming Bolsa Família is an 'acquired right', stating he is 'falling in the polls' and 'pretending to defend' the program. The party highlighted contradictions with his past stance and that of former President Jair Bolsonaro, who consistently opposed Bolsa Família. Flávio proposed extending benefits for those entering formal employment but did not detail how it would be funded.

item.title: Em meio a revelações do Master, Ciro Nogueira falta a reunião de partidos com TSE
item.description: The national president of the PP, Ciro Nogueira, one of the political figures most implicated in the Master case, was absent from a TSE meeting to discuss electoral process integrity. His absence comes amid growing pressure on politicians involved in the alleged vote-buying scandal.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: Vazamento mostra Lula renegando a esquerda para o FMI
item.description: A leaked conversation between Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva, and German Chancellor Friedrich Merz shows Lula stating he 'was never of the left'. The remark, disclosed on the program Papo Antagonista, sparked controversy by suggesting an ideological distancing from his traditional base. The episode raises questions about Lula’s political consistency amid international alliances and external economic pressures.

item.title: Nunes Marques é sorteado para analisar queixa de Flávio contra Lula por ameaça
item.description: Minister Nunes Marques was randomly assigned to report the criminal complaint filed by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro against President Lula, alleging threat and incitement to crime, after Lula called the Bolsonaros 'traitors of the homeland' and incorrectly cited Joaquim Silvério dos Reis as hanged for denouncing Tiradentes in the Inconfidência Mineira.

item.title: TSE firma acordo com partidos pela integridade eleitoral
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques signed a commitment term with 26 of 30 registered political parties to strengthen the integrity of the 2026 elections, focusing on combating disinformation, responsible AI use, inclusion, and electoral trust. The agreement, which imposes no new legal obligations, includes commitments such as candidate guidance, accessibility, defense of electoral system security, and modernization of tools like Candex and Conta+ JE.

item.title: Planalto reage a fala de Trump e defende contra-ataque
item.description: The Brazilian government reacted to statements by U.S. President Donald Trump about Brazil's political landscape, calling them dangerous and an improper interference in the 2026 elections. President Lula stated Trump has no right to interfere in Brazilian elections and defended the electronic voting system as a model of electoral tranquility. Diplomats at Itamaraty expressed concern about potential foreign interference signals in the 2026 electoral process.

item.title: Congresso deve votar nesta quinta-feira veto de Lula aos jabutis das eólicas offshore
item.description: The National Congress is set to vote this Thursday on President Lula's vetoes to provisions of the bill regulating offshore wind energy, including the mandatory contracting of gas-fired thermal plants, known as a 'jabuti'. Lula vetoed these provisions in January 2025, arguing they distorted the environmental focus of the legislation. The vote will take place in a congressional session and could either uphold or overturn the presidential vetoes.

item.title: PEC do Trabalho Flexível “não retira direitos”, diz Rogério Marinho
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho (PL-RN), author of the Flexible Work PEC, argued that the proposal does not remove workers' rights, stating that all rights under Article 7 of the Constitution are preserved and that it merely incorporates existing CLT mechanisms, such as flexible working hours by individual agreement. He accused the Lula government of spreading false information and labeled the debate as electoral, advocating for the PEC to be attached to the 6X1 scale PEC for simultaneous Senate vote, with public hearings and economic impact studies.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro participa da estreia de ‘Dark Horse’ nos EUA: ‘Pesadelo para a esquerda’
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro attended the premiere of the film 'Dark Horse', based on his father's trajectory, in Las Vegas, calling it a 'nightmare for the left' and emphasizing its goal of international success. He discussed legal actions by Lula's allies to block the film, which were dismissed by the TSE, and criticized the STF, referencing his recent conviction for coercion in the course of justice. The film was heavily financed by banker Daniel Vorcaro, currently imprisoned and under investigation for financial fraud, with suspicions that funds were diverted to support Eduardo's stay in the U.S.

item.title: Trump ameaça o Brasil. Estaria querendo Lula eleito no primeiro turno?
item.description: Donald Trump threatened Brazil, suggesting the U.S. might interfere in the electoral process to ensure Lula’s victory in the first round, citing alleged deals over rare earths and Pix. The author interprets this as pressure on Brazil, confusing figures like Eduardo Bolsonaro with Flávio Bolsonaro, and frames the election as a clash between democracy vs. coupism and sovereignty vs. submission.

item.title: Nunes Marques é sorteado relator de processo de Flávio Bolsonaro contra Lula por 'ameaça'
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Kassio Nunes Marques has been randomly assigned as the rapporteur in a case filed by Flávio Bolsonaro against President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, alleging charges of threat and incitement to crime. The case stems from public statements made by Lula regarding Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, son of former president Jair Bolsonaro. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Rogerinho, Fica Comigo e Banda Eva animam 2º fim de semana do Na Praia
item.description: The second weekend of the Na Praia Festival in 2026 features Rogerinho and Fica Comigo energizing the post-match atmosphere after the Brazil vs. Haiti game on Friday, followed by the Arraiá dos Rosa on Saturday with children's activities and a June festival theme. On Sunday, the event continues with an intimate performance by Banda Eva and Nossa Galera on the floating Palco Praia in Lake Paranoá, offering pagode, axé, and sunset views on the sand. The programming includes family-friendly options, with the 'Dia de Praia' ticket available on Saturdays and Sundays for access to common areas, pools, and the gastronomic village.

item.title: 'Não se meta nas eleições do Brasil', diz Lula após fala de Trump citando Bolsonaros
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva responded to Donald Trump's remarks, in which Trump called Brazil 'politically dangerous' and referenced the possible arrest of Eduardo Bolsonaro, stating that Trump may continue to like the Bolsonaro family but must not interfere in Brazil's elections, as they are an internal Brazilian matter. Lula stressed the importance of respecting national sovereignty and the ethical code between nations.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro lançará plano de segurança pública para tentar virar página após caso 'Dark Horse'
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) will unveil his public security plan in São Paulo on Thursday, targeting criminal factions such as the Red Command and PCC, as part of his effort to rebuild his image following the 'Dark Horse' case.

item.title: Por que os craques dos outros países são mais longevos?
item.description: Brazilian stars who led the 1994 and 2002 World Cup-winning teams ended their international careers before age 30, often due to injuries, technical decisions, or off-field issues like indiscipline and lifestyle. In contrast, Cristiano Ronaldo (41), Lionel Messi (38), and Luka Modrić (40) remain elite performers in the 2026 World Cup, sustained by discipline, physical care, and professionalism. The contrast shows that longevity in elite football depends more on habits and career management than raw talent alone.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro pede que Trump volte a sancionar Moraes após condenação no STF
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro, former federal deputy convicted by Brazil's STF, urged U.S. President Donald Trump to reinstate sanctions against Justice Alexandre de Moraes under the Magnitsky Act. The request was made on Wednesday, June 17, 2026, following his conviction in the Supreme Federal Court. The proposed sanctions would include financial penalties and U.S. entry restrictions.

item.title: Comissão aprova perdão a caminhoneiros envolvidos em ato bolsonarista
item.description: The Mixed Committee approved the substitute of MP 1.343/2026, which pardons fines for truckers involved in Bolsonarist acts after the 2022 elections, including judicial fines, active debt, and ongoing collections. The text also reduces sanctions for overloaded transport, converting infractions into warnings. The project now proceeds to the Chamber floor.

item.title: Tribunal aprova contas de 2025 de Tarcísio em SP, mas aponta ressalvas
item.description: The São Paulo State Court of Accounts (TCE-SP) unanimously approved, but with reservations, Governor Tarcísio de Freitas’ 2025 accounts, citing issues such as opaque fiscal renunciations, a corruption scheme in the State Treasury involving over R$1 billion in bribes, and failures in highway contract oversight and health unit management. Rapporteur Bertaiolli described a 'parallel budget of fiscal waivers' and urged transparency on beneficiaries and annual monitoring of tax exemption impacts. Despite recurring reservations since 2021, the court ruled against rejecting the accounts due to absence of fraudulent intent, emphasizing the need for continuous improvement.

item.title: Condenação de Eduardo Bolsonaro fura bolha da Copa e lidera debate político nas redes
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro was sentenced to four years and two months in prison by the STF for coercion in attempting to interfere with his father Jair Bolsonaro's conviction. The unanimous ruling triggered a 242.7% surge in social media mentions over two days, making him the 9th most searched term on Google Trends Brazil and breaking through the World Cup discourse in Trending Topics.

item.title: Indecisos abrem caminho para derrotar Lula no 2º turno, diz Caiado
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado states that the growing number of undecided voters will be decisive in defeating Lula in a potential runoff, as former Flávio Bolsonaro supporters have shifted to the independent bloc, creating space for a third-way candidate. He argues the opposition must present a candidate with superior governance experience and profile to win over these undecided voters and prevent Lula from gaining strength heading into the second round. Caiado denies his remarks constitute criticism of Bolsonaro, insisting they are based solely on polling data.

item.title: Lula diz que não tem nenhuma queixa contra a China
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated at the G7 summit in France that he has no complaints against China, noting that the Asian country filled commercial and investment spaces left vacant by the United States and the European Union. He emphasized that Brazil’s trade surplus with China stands at $165 billion and urged wealthy nations to increase investments in poorer regions to stimulate global economic growth.

item.title: Mendonça vota pela cassação de deputados do Podemos no Amapá acusados de usar candidatas laranjas
item.description: Minister André Mendonça, rapporteur of the case at the TSE, voted for the annulment of Podemos state deputies in Amapá due to gender quota fraud, acknowledging the party used three dummy female candidates in the 2022 elections. The trial was suspended by a view request from Minister Dias Toffoli and will resume on April 23.

item.title: Após G7, Lula reage a comentários de Trump sobre Bolsonaro e eleições: 'não se meta no Brasil'
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva responded to Donald Trump's comments regarding the conviction of Eduardo Bolsonaro, stating that the U.S. should not interfere in Brazil's internal affairs. Lula emphasized national sovereignty and rejected any foreign meddling in Brazilian elections.

item.title: Lula diz não ter conversado com Trump no G7 sobre tarifas
item.description: President Lula stated he did not discuss tariffs with Trump during the G7 summit in France, despite attending after the U.S. announced potential extra tariffs on Brazilian goods. He said he did not request a bilateral meeting because trade negotiations are ongoing through officials, and called the tariff plan 'outrageous'. Lula also criticized the U.S. designation of CV and PCC as terrorist groups, arguing they are financially motivated, not seeking to replace the state.
